scope: external standards only; outside natural/control denominators

records.receiver_check: ro record exists and includes the old associated names
records.meaning_of_alias: BCP47 canonicalization mapping scoped to language tags; not software equivalence
records.repair_action: preserve original mo citation and observation edition; add dated directed preferred-value link to ro
records.counterexample: STD-S08 is an earlier July description update, not the November deprecation source
records.unknown: historical HTTP redirect; original ISO639-2 source decision text
records.reopen_condition: obtain original ISO change row if source-standard approval itself is required

records.receiver_check: all four records exist, Added=2010-03-11 and Macrolanguage=bik
records.meaning_of_alias: four destinations are not four interchangeable aliases; mapping old material requires context
records.repair_action: preserve old bhk; retain four typed directed links; withhold one-destination automatic replacement
records.counterexample: picking fbl simply because it is first in Comments loses three alternatives
records.unknown: the correct successor for any particular legacy bhk content; original SIL decision PDF contents
records.reopen_condition: one distinguishing content/region/language evidence item for the old record, plus original change request if needed

scope_boundaries: same registry multiple records count one original work
IANA mo/ro not substituted with ISO639-3 mol/ron
current HTTP responses do not prove past redirect behavior
standards are not software behavior tests
